name: Wendy Darling
original_name: ウェンディ・ダーリング
source:
Lost her father when she was young, and brought up alone by her mother.

She attempts to not let it surface, but due to the influences of her past, she’s a lonely person.

She’s a hard-worker, and cherishes her family.

As the eldest daughter, she behaves brilliantly, but she often idles away aimlessly.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at Livejournal[/url]]
